title: Promise of a Savior
summary: Even in mankind’s first fall, God promised a Savior who would conquer sin and restore hope for all generations through His Son, Jesus Christ.
scripture: “And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.” - Genesis 3:15

title: Prophecy of a Virgin Birth
summary: God promised a miraculous sign: a child born of a virgin who would be called Immanuel, meaning 'God with us.'
scripture: “Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel.” - Isaiah 7:14

title: Isaiah Foretells the Messiah
summary: Isaiah prophesied a child who would bring peace, justice, and salvation to a broken world.
scripture: “For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.” - Isaiah 9:6

title: The Coming King from David’s Line
summary: God promised a king from David’s family who would reign forever with justice and righteousness.
scripture: “Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me; your throne will be established forever.” - 2 Samuel 7:16

title: The Star Foretold
summary: A star was promised to shine, guiding the world to the Savior who would bring hope and light.
scripture: “A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel.” - Numbers 24:17

title: The Suffering Servant
summary: Isaiah foretold a Servant who would suffer for humanity’s sins, bringing healing, peace, and redemption through His sacrifice.
scripture: “But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on Him, and by His wounds we are healed.” - Isaiah 53:5
